description: Olympus EPL2 digital camera: normalized R, G and B channel spectral sensitivities (400-720 nm, 10 nm steps) from the RIT Camera Spectral Sensitivity Database (Jiang et al. 2013).
facility_description: Digital cameras (DSLRs, mirrorless, compact, industrial, cinema and phone cameras) whose RGB channel spectral sensitivities or internal IR/UV-cut filter transmissions have been measured.
notes: RGB curves checked this session: NJM values are identical (max abs diff 0) to the 'Olympus E-PL2' entry of http://www.gujinwei.org/research/camspec/camspec_database.txt.
